type NullableValue = { kind: 'a'; value: string | null } | { kind: 'b'; value: number };
function inspect(value: NullableValue) {
  if (value.value === undefined) console.log(value.kind);
  if (value.value === null) {
    const kind: 'a' | 'b' = value.kind;
    console.log(kind);
  } else {
    const defined: string | number = value.value;
    console.log(defined);
  }
}
function same(value: { tag: 'same'; left: number } | { tag: 'same'; right: number }) {
  if (value.tag === undefined) console.log(value.tag);
  console.log(value.tag);
}
function literal(value: { code?: 'a' | 'b'; tag: 'left' } | { code: 'c'; tag: 'right' }) {
  if (value.code === 'c') { const result: 'right' = value.tag; console.log(result); }
  if (value.code === undefined) { const result: 'left' = value.tag; console.log(result); }
}
function patterned(value: { tag: `a-${number}`; left: string } | { tag: `b-${number}`; right: string }) {
  if (value.tag === 'a-1') console.log(value.left);
}
function unit(value: { kind: 'a'; part: string | null } | { kind: 'b'; part: null }) {
  if (value.part !== null) { const result: 'a' = value.kind; console.log(result); }
}
inspect({ kind: 'a', value: null });
inspect({ kind: 'b', value: 3 });
same({ tag: 'same', left: 4 });
literal({ code: 'c', tag: 'right' });
literal({ tag: 'left' });
patterned({ tag: 'a-1', left: 'pattern' });
unit({ kind: 'a', part: 'narrow' });
